<thought>Since the direct esterification precursors (the bicyclic carboxylic acid and methanol) are not both commercially available, I will look for a retrosynthetic template that can construct the entire target molecule in a single step from two simple, readily purchasable building blocks. A common way to build bicyclic frameworks with a ketone and an ester is a Diels‑Alder cycloaddition between a diene and a dienophile that already contains the carbonyl and ester functionalities. I will search the template catalog for reactions that form a new six‑membered ring (bond type “6‑6”) and that create a carbonyl (ketone) and an ester in the product.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "COC([C@]12CC=CC[C@H]1C(C2)=O)=O",
  "bonds_formed": ["6-6"],
  "functional_groups_formed": ["ketones", "carboxylic esters"],
  "limit": 5
}
</action_input>
